text: Yes, a tree-cover loss event of 13.5 ha was detected in 2025 on this property, pending corroboration. While 2021–2024 showed no detectable loss, the 2025 finding is supported by satellite observations (Hansen GFC) and aligns with the 2020 forest baseline (JRC GFC2020). However, the cause, persistence, and legality of the loss remain unconfirmed. Changes smaller than 0.5 ha or at boundaries may not be captured.
